objective: Convert decisive Iteration 005 worst-case quorum bounds into independently checkable exact rational proof objects.
claim_boundary: Certificates prove exact extrema for one frozen triplet/quorum under the published marginals. The certificate does not assert that either extremal distribution occurs in deployment; it proves non-certifiability from those marginals alone.
next_proof_obligation: Obtain per-case heterogeneous evaluator outputs or independently execute evaluators; estimate dependence with uncertainty and test a frozen controller on locked holdout data.
